which gcc g++ cc || true; cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap && tail -60 config.log || true && rm -f config.cache Makefile config.status && ./configure CC=gcc CFLAGS='-g -O1 -fsanitize=address' LDFLAGS='-fsanitize=address' --disable-shared >/tmp/configure.log 2>&1 && make -j2 >/tmp/make.log 2>&1 && cat >/tmp/driver.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <pcap/pcap.h>
int main(int argc,char**argv){if(argc<2)return 2;FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb");if(!f){perror("fopen");return 2;}fseek(f,0,SEEK_END);long sz=ftell(f);rewind(f);if(sz<1)return 0;unsigned char*d=malloc(sz);fread(d,1,sz,f);fclose(f);pcap_t*pkts=pcap_open_dead(d[sz-1],0xffff);char*filter=malloc(sz);memcpy(filter,d,sz);filter[sz-1]=0;struct bpf_program bpf;int r=pcap_compile(pkts,&bpf,filter,1,PCAP_NETMASK_UNKNOWN);fprintf(stderr,"compile=%d err=%s size=%ld\n",r,pcap_geterr(pkts),sz);if(r==0){pcap_freecode(&bpf);}pcap_close(pkts);free(filter);free(d);return 0;}
EOF
